Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Alok Kumar Verma
 08Th October, 2025
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.1098 of 2025
Magan Bhasin and Another .....Applicants
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Others .....Respondents
Counsel for the Applicants : Mr. Prasoon Dhariyal,
 Advocate.

entities.text:
High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Akshay Latwal,
Nos.1 and 2 Assistant Government  Advocate assisted by  Mr. Prabhat Kandpal,
 Brief Holder.

The present Application has been filed by the applicants for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.61 of 2022, registered at Police Station Selaqui, District Dehradun under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
According to the First Information Report dated 28.02.2022, the co-accused Sunita Sharma prepared a fake will of late Harjeet Singh Narula, the father of the informant, on 20.01.2021.
Magan Bhasin and Satya Prasad Suyal (applicants) are witnesses to the said will.
3. Heard Mr. Prasoon Dhariyal, learned counsel for the applicants and Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for the respondent.
4. Mr. Prasoon Dhariyal, Advocate, submitted that the applicants were the friends of the informant's father.
The said will is real and genuine.

An Original Suit (O.S. No.137 of 2021) was filed by Smt.
Sunita against the informant and the said suit has been decreed ex-parte on 14.12.2023.

sentences.text: Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate, on instructions, has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the Anticipatory Bail Application.

7. Having heard the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicants Magan Bhasin and Satya Prasad Suyal, they shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/ Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicants shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and they shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
8. List on 12.11.2025 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
